ဘေးမှကြဉ်အပ်သည်။
DOP: bhaya n. and mfn. [ ts ], ( sg. instr. bhayena, bhayasā; pl. nom. bhayāni, bhayā); 1. ( n. ) ( i ) fear, fright, dread; Abh 166 (~am uttāso); Vin I 25, 23* (abhīto pāvisi ~am atīto); II 156, 9 (yaṃ ahosi ~aṃ chambitattaṃ lomahaṃso so paṭippassambhi); III 146, 5 (isi tassa nāgassa ~ā kiso ahosi lūkho); IV 309, 12 (paribhāseyya vā ti ~aṃ upadaṃseti); S I 104, 4 (Māro pāpimā bhagavato ~aṃ chambhitattaṃ lomahaṃsaṃ uppādetukāmo); Dhp 212 (piyato jāyatī soko piyato jāyatī ~aṃ); Sn 576 (evaṃ jātānaṃ maccānaṃ niccaṃ maraṇato ~aṃ); 936 (maṃ ~aṃ āvisi); Th 20 (maraṇe me ~aṃ natthi nikanti natthi jīvite); 307 (balākā … kāḷassa meghassa ~ena tajjitā); 707 (atikkantā ~ā sabbe khīṇasaṃyojanassa ve); Ja I 334, 3 (bhante ettake vo core disvā ~aṃ vā sārajjaṃ vā na uppajjī ti); II 2, 21 (ete mayhaṃ ~enāpi aguṇaṃ avatvā guṇam eva vadeyyun ti); 405, 10 (koci-d-eva naṃ khādeyyā ti ~ena); III 146, 19 (yakkho Sakkassa ~ena bodhisattaṃ paharituṃ na sakkoti); VI 3, 30 (ath’ assa pakatiyā pi bhītassa atirekataraṃ ~aṃ uppajji); 165, 31´ (Kāsīnaṃ ~aṃ janento); 250, 25* (~asānutappāmi mahā ca me ~ā, Ee, Se so; Ce bhayaṃ; Be ~ā ’nutappāmi; 251, 5´ foll.: attanā katassa pāpassa ~ena anutappāmi … mahantaṃ ca me nirayabhayaṃ uppannaṃ); Mil 22, 27 (atha kho Milindassa rañño sahasā Nāgaseno ti saddaṃ sutvā ahu-d-eva ~aṃ ahu-d-eva chambhitattaṃ ahu-d-eva lomahaṃso); Vism 417, 29 (tato nesaṃ ~aṃ nāsetvā sūrabhāvaṃ janayantaṃ … suriyamaṇḍalaṃ pātubhavati); Sv 149, 21 (cittutrāsabhayaṃ ñāṇabhayaṃ ārammaṇabhayaṃ ottappabhayan ti catubbidhaṃ ~aṃ); 266, 4 (sakalasarīre sañjātasedo ~ena vedhamāno aṭṭhāsi); It-a I 73, 14 (sīhaṃ disvā ~aṃ hotī ti); — abl. bhayā ( and bhayāhi? cf kāmāhi [ sv kāma] and K.R. Norman, 1981b, pp. 171–72 ), out of fear; D III 182, 13* (chandā dosā ~ā mohā yo dhammaṃ ativattati); Ja I 336, 17* (eḷakānaṃ ~āhi; 342, 17´ : hikāro pan’ ettha nipātamattam eva, Ce, Ee so; not in Be, Se ); V 165, 18* (na ~ā na dosā vācaṃ musā pabbajitā bhaṇanti); 497, 25* (chiddaṃ te raṭṭhaṃ vyathitā ~ā hi puthū narā lenam anuppaviṭṭhā, Be, Se so; Ce vyathitaṃ; Ee vyādhitaṃ; 498, 2´ : tava ~ena kampitā, Be, Se so; Ce kampitaṃ; Ee kampamānā); — ( ii ) a cause of fear, danger, calamity; peril; D I 69, 33 (sa … bhikkhu evaṃ sīlasampanno na kutoci ~aṃ samanupassati yad idaṃ sīlasaṃvarato); S I 2, 24* (etaṃ ~aṃ maraṇe pekkhamāno); II 68, 20 foll. (gahapati pāṇātipātī … diṭṭhadhammikaṃ pi ~aṃ veraṃ pasavati samparāyikaṃ pi ~aṃ veraṃ pasavati); A I 178, 20 (~aṃ hoti aṭavīsaṅkopo cakkasamārūḷhā jānapadā pariyāyanti); III 213, 19* (nirayesu ~aṃ disvā pāpāni parivajjaye); It 69, 12* (upadhīsu ~aṃ disvā; It-a II 64, 29 : tesaṃ bhāyitabbataṃ passitvā); Sn 51 (etaṃ ~aṃ kāmaguṇesu disvā); Th 21 (nāhaṃ ~assa bhāyāmi; Th-a I 80, 20 foll.: bhāyanti etasmā ti ~aṃ … ~assā ti nissakke sāmivacanaṃ, ~ato bhāyitabbanimittaṃ jātijarāmaraṇādinā hetunā nāhaṃ bhāyāmi, so read with Be, Ce, Se ); Ja I 337, 11 (itonidānaṃ pi te ~aṃ natthi); 389, 2* (vissāsā ~am anveti); 466, 6 (Piliyaseṭṭhissa kenaci-d-eva kāraṇena mahantaṃ ~aṃ uppajji sabbaṃ sāpateyyaṃ parihāyi); 485, 18 (eko kāko gantvā kākānaṃ uppannaṃ ~aṃ bodhisattassa ārocesi); II 336, 8* (tasmiṃ ~asmiṃ); III 399, 4* (tasmā rāja pavedhāmi sampassaṃ ’nāgataṃ ~aṃ); IV 163, 17* (eko ~aṃ saṃsati khemam eko); VI 188, 9 (~en’ assa uppannena bhavitabban ti); Paṭis I 13, 6 (uppādo ~aṃ anuppādo kheman ti); Cp 2:4:1 (bhavaṃ disvāna ~ato); Vibh 376, 24 foll. (katamāni cattāri ~āni); Mil 404, 7 (satapatto ravitvā paresaṃ khemaṃ vā ~aṃ vā ācikkhati); Vism 3, 28 (saṃsāre ~aṃ ikkhatī ti bhikkhu); Ps II 399, 24 (so mahantaṃ ~aṃ na sakkā idha yāpetuṃ paratīraṃ gamissāmī ti); Dhp-a III 366, 1 (ekaṃ ~aṃ bhavissatī ti, kiṃ ~aṃ nāmā ti, chātakabhayaṃ seṭṭhī ti); Pj II 87, 20 (mettaṃ bhāvema … upekhaṃ bhāvema tena no taṃ ~aṃ na hotī ti); — ifc see akutobhaya, attānuvāda- ( sv atta[n] ), anuyoga-, udakapātana-, upalepa-, ubbijjanaka-, parānuvāda- ( sv para ); — 2. ( mfn. ) dangerous, risky; Dhp 123 (vāṇijo va ~aṃ maggaṃ appasattho mahaddhano … parivajjaye; Dhp-a III 23, 21 : ~an ti bhāyitabbaṃ, corehi pariyuṭṭhitattā sappaṭibhayan ti attho); — ° âgati , f. , a wrong course of behaviour because of fear; Vin III 238, 26 (yo … na ~iṃ gaccheyya); D III 133, 23 (abhabbo khīṇāsavo bhikkhu ~iṃ gantuṃ); Vibh 376, 2 ; Peṭ 64, 6 ; — ° ûparata , mfn. , abstaining (from wrong-doing) out of fear; M I 319, 6 (abhayūparato ayaṃ āyasmā nāyaṃ āyasmā ~o); Pp 13, 5 (satta sekhā ~ā ye ca puthujjanā sīlavanto; Pp-a 184, 11 : bhāyitvā bhāyitvā pāpato oramanti pāpaṃ na karonti); — neg. abhayūparata, mfn. , Pp 13, 6 (arahā abhayūparato; Pp-a 184, 28 : so hi sabbaso samucchinnabhayo); Ps II 385, 4 foll. (abhayūparato ti abhayo hutvā uparato … na vā bhayena uparato ti); — ° ûvara , mfn. , see abhayūvara below; — °-m- erita , mfn. , moved, stirred, by fear; Ja IV 424, 16* (424, 22´ : °’-eritā °-tajjitā °-calitā) = V 359, 24* ; — °-ṅ- kara , mfn. , causing fear; terrible; Abh 167; 928 (~e, Be so; Ce sayaṅkare, prob. wr ); 989; — °- gāmi(n) , mfn. [bhaya + gāmi(n) 1 ], influenced by fear; Vin III 183, 34 (°-gāmitā pāpenti; Sp 625, 26 foll.: ete chandagāmino … ~ino cā ti evaṃ … °-gāmitāya pi pāpenti); 184, 19 (~ino ca bhikkhū); IV 238, 2 (~iniyo ca bhikkhuniyo); — °- cakita , mfn. , trembling with fear; alarmed at the danger; Dāṭh 4:46 (samuddo … ~-manussakkandito); — °- janana , mf (~ī) n. and n. , 1. ( mfn. ) causing fear; frightening; Th 1094 (~iṃ … taṇhālataṃ … chetvā); Ja IV 26, 30´ (bhīmāya ~iyā mahatiyā kilesasenāya); 141, 17 (~o saddo); V 272, 15´ (~-tāya); Pv-a 251, 1 ; Mhv 2:33 (yo ~iṃ aniccataṃ avekkhate); — 2. ( n. ) causing fear; frightening; Ja I 457, 8 (ārakkhamanussānaṃ ~’-atthaṃ); Vv-a 213, 24 (~ato); — °- dassana , n. , 1. seeing danger; Ud-a 32, 15 (pahānaṃ … ~ena sabhaye abhayasaññāya) = It-a I 39, 15 ; — 2. showing danger, producing fear, threatening; Sp 1013, 7 (~ena ca tajjeti); Mp III 327, 3 (~ena paribhāsako); Vibh-a 341, 1 (taṃ paharissāmā … vadhissāmā ti evaṃ ~ena paribhāsanti); — °- dassāvi(n) , mfn. , who has seen or sees the danger; Vin IV 51, 23 (ācāragocarasampanno aṇumattesu vajjesu ~ī) = D I 63, 15 = Vibh 244, 5 (Vibh-a 343, 1 : ~ī ti catubbidhassa bhayassa kāraṇattā bhayato dassanasīlo) ≠ M I 33, 8 (viharatha ācāragocarasampannā … ~ino, Be so; Ce, Ee, Se ~ī) = A II 14, 15 (~ino); Mil 325, 26 (tassa pavatte ~issa evaṃ cittaṃ uppajjati); 408, 16 foll. (yoginā … pamāde ~inā bhavitabbaṃ … tāya ca pana °-dassāvitāya …); Sadd 845, 8 (bhayaṃ passatī ti ~ī); — °- dassi(n) , mfn. , seeing fear or a cause of fear; Dhp 317 (abhaye ~ino); Thī 346 (kāmesu ~iniṃ); Sv 181, 19 (~ī); — °- dassiva(t) , mfn. , seeing the danger; Dhp 31 (pamāde °-dassivā); — °- pāṭikaṅkhi(n) , °-paṭikaṅkhi(n), mfn. , expecting fear; M I 21, 4 (~ī, Ce so; Be, Ee, Se °-paṭikaṅkhī); — °- bherava , m.n. and mfn. , 1. ( m.n. ) fear and terror; M I 17, 15 (te bhonto samaṇabrāhmaṇā akusalaṃ ~aṃ avhayanti; Ps I 113, 33 : ~an ti bhayaṃ ca bheravaṃ ca); 21, 2 (etaṃ nūna taṃ ~aṃ āgacchatī ti); A V 132, 19 (na ca maṃ ~o saheyya); Ap 400, 29 (~aṃ na passāmi); Sp 65, 8* (na me paṭibalo assa janetuṃ ~aṃ); Ap-a 130, 13 (yesaṃ ca ~ā pahīnā te thāvarā); Mhv 12:18 (n’ eva me sakkuṇeyyāsi janetuṃ ~aṃ); — 2. ( mfn. ) inspiring fear and dread; S I 113, 14 (mahantaṃ ~-saddaṃ akāsi; Spk I 178, 14 : bhayajanakasaddaṃ); — abhaya , mfn. and n. , 1. ( mfn. ) free from fear, fearless; free from danger; safe; S I 33, 9* (~ā nāma sā disā; Spk I 87, 19 foll.: nibbānaṃ sandhāy’ āha, tasmiṃ hi kiñci bhayaṃ natthi taṃ pattassa bhayaṃ natthī ti); Dhp 258 (khemī averī ~o paṇḍito ti pavuccati); Th 82 (yena yena subhikkhāni sivāni ~āni ca tena puttaka gacchassu; Th-a I 187, 31 foll.: subhikkhānī ti sulabhapiṇḍāni raṭṭhānī ti adhippāyo … ~ānī ti corabhayādīhi nibbhayāni); Thī 512 (ajarāmarapadaṃ asokaṃ … akhalitaṃ ~aṃ); Ja V 406, 27´ (khemino ti ~ā); Ap 47, 2 (pāvisiṃ ~aṃ puraṃ; Ap-a 291, 19 : bhayarahitaṃ nibbānapuraṃ); Mil 351, 24 (dhutaṅgaṃ … ~aṃ asampīḷaṃ …); Vism 64, 14 (corabhayena ~-tā); 239, 17 (~o asammūḷho kālaṃ karoti); — 2. ( n. ) absence or removal of fear or danger; what is not a danger; immunity, protection from punishment or danger; safety; D II 259, 3* (~aṃ tadā nāgarājānam āsi); S I 154, 23* (bhayā pamutto ~e vimutto; Spk I 220, 27 : bhayā ti vaṭṭabhayato, ~e ti nibbāne); 227, 24* (~aṃ yācamānānaṃ bhayam eva dadāmi vo); A IV 246, 7 (pāṇātipātā paṭivirato … ariyasāvako aparimāṇānaṃ sattānaṃ ~aṃ deti); Dhp 317 (~e bhayadassino bhaye cābhayadassino); Ja I 150, 17 (rājā … dve suvaṇṇamige disvā tesaṃ ~aṃ adāsi); II 53, 23* (~ā bhayam uppannaṃ); IV 80, 16 (sā ~aṃ yācitvā taṃ antaraṃ kathesi); 157, 16* (~aṃ samma dammi te; 157, 21´ : nāhaṃ taṃ chedāpessāmi); 262, 8 (rājā sabbasattānaṃ ~aṃ dammī ti nagare bheriṃ carāpesi); VI 20, 14* (~aṃ samma te dammi abhīto bhaṇa sārathi); Peṭ 155, 5 (mātuyā vā pituno vā … ~aṃ deti); Mil 323, 25 (nibbānaṃ … nirupaddavato ~ato khemato … daṭṭhabbaṃ); Sv 835, 14 (moranivāpo ti … yattha morānaṃ ~ena saddhiṃ nivāpo dinno); Ps IV 22, 4 (cattāro … ~assa bhāyanti); Pj II 121, 21 (khuddakarājā taṃ māremī ti purato dhāvati, paṭirājā taṃ ~aṃ yāci); Mhv 37:193 (~aṃ sabbapāṇinaṃ); — abhayūvara, mfn. [ cf bhayūparata above ?], immune, untouchable; ( or : not restrained by fear; ?) Vin I 75, 12 (abhayūvarā ime samaṇā Sakyaputtiyā na-y-ime labbhā kiñci kātuṃ; cf Sp 997, 27 foll.: ettha bhayena uparamantī ti bhayūvarā, ete pana laddhābhayattā na bhayūvarā ti abhayūvarā. pakārassa c’ ettha vakāro kuto ci veditabbo); — ~-ghosa, m. [abhaya + ghosa 1 ], a proclamation of immunity; Sv 941, 18 (~-ghosaṃ ca ghosāpesi) = Ud-a 60, 12 ( Be, Ce, Se so; Ee ~-ghosanaṃ; = Pj II 419, 25 : eds ~-ghosanaṃ); — ~-ghosana, n. or ~ā, f. [abhaya + ghosana 1 ], id.; Ja IV 424, 5 (~-ghosanaṃ ghosāpesi); Sp 576, 1 ; Pj II 419, 25 ; — ~-dassi(n), mfn. , seeing no cause of fear; Dhp 317; — atibhaya , n. , great fear; Sp 401, 15 ; — nibbhaya , mfn. and n. , 1. ( mfn. ) free from fear or suspicion; fearless, confident; free from danger; safe; Ja I 334, 12´ (asaṅkiyo ~o nirāsaṅko); 389, 4´ (yo pubbe sabhayo … yo pubbe ~o …, Be, Se so; Ce, Ee sahāyo … ~o); III 80, 11 (~o hutvā yaṃ vo ruccati taṃ yācathā ti); 193, 12´ (mātu hadaye putto viya nirāsaṅko ~o seti); 273, 13 (mahāsatto … ~o hutvā mettaṃ purecārikaṃ katvā); V 356, 22 (khemaṃ ~aṃ saran ti paramparāghosena nānāhaṃsā āgamiṃsu); VI 338, 31´ (~-tāya); Ps IV 97, 23 (ekacco pana puthujjano pi atisūro hoti ~o); Dhp-a II 250, 15* (~aṃ maraṇaṃ hoti); Pj II 34, 18 (~e ṭhāne ṭhito); — 2. ( n. ) what is free from fear or danger; safety; Nidd-a I 452, 22 (catūhi yogehi khemaṃ ~aṃ na icchanti sabhayam eva icchanti) ≠ Ps II 85, 5 ( eds nibbhayaṭṭhānaṃ); — sabhaya , mfn. and n. , 1. ( mfn. ) ( i ) dangerous; full of risk; Vin III 162, 20 (yāyaṃ bhante disā abhayā anītikā … sāyaṃ disā ~ā sa-ītikā); S IV 195, 18 (~o c’ eso maggo); Thī 352 (paripantho eso ~o); Ap 503, 7 (saṃsāre ~e vasaṃ); Ud-a 161, 27 (~aṃ sapariḷāhaṃ rajjasukhaṃ); Pj II 34, 19 (~e eva ca so ṭhāne ṭhito); Paṭis-a 394, 3 (lokavajjadvayaṃ pi hi bhayavatthuttā sayaṃ ca ~-ttā, Be, Se so; Ce, Ee bhayavatthuttā bhayaṃ ca bhayattā); — ( ii ) fearful; lacking confidence; Sv 539, 9 = Ud-a 417, 14 (~o upasaṅkamati); — 2. ( n. ) what is dangerous; where there is danger; danger; Mil 91, 26 (visamaṭṭhānaṃ parivajjanīyaṃ ~aṃ parivajjanīyaṃ); Vism 694, 8 (~e abhayasaññāya) ≠ Ps I 23, 16 = Ud-a 32, 15 ( Be, Se so; Ce omits; Ee ~esu) = It-a I 39, 16 ( eds ~esu) = Paṭis-a 448, 12 ( eds so ); Nidd-a I 452, 22 (~am eva icchanti, Be, Ee, Se so; Ce bhayaṃ; ≠ Ps II 85, 5 : eds bhayam).
